chore(deps): bump dynamo-renderer to 5.1.2
selected_pull_requests.body:
## Overview:

Bump `dynamo-renderer` from 5.1.0 to 5.1.2. This release includes the strict-system-template handling added in ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#164, resolving the Anthropic Messages API failure reported in #14550.

The failure occurs when Claude Code sends a non-leading `system` message and the target model uses a chat template that requires all system content to appear first.

## Details:

- Upgrade `dynamo-renderer` from 5.1.0 to 5.1.2.
- Upgrade `dynamo-tokenizers` from 1.8.0 to 1.8.1 to satisfy the renderer's dependency requirement.
- Refresh the root, Python binding, and KVBM lockfiles without unrelated dependency churn.
- Add a focused regression test for rendering a Claude Code-shaped Anthropic request through a template that requires the system message to be first.

## Where should the reviewer start?

- `Cargo.toml` for the frontend crate version updates.
- `lib/llm/src/preprocessor.rs` for the accompanying regression test.

## Compatibility Notes

This upgrade also includes the DeepSeek V4 reasoning-effort fixes from ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#199:

- Omitted or invalid effort defaults to `high`.
- `minimal` and `low` keep thinking enabled without an effort prefix.
- `medium`, `high`, and `xhigh` use the high-effort prefix.
- `max` uses the maximum-effort prefix.
- `none` disables thinking.
- Top-level `reasoning_effort` takes precedence over the template argument.

These changes are unrelated to #14550 but are included in `dynamo-renderer` 5.1.1.

## Validation

- `cargo test -j 8 -p dynamo-llm --lib --locked preprocessor::tests::test_nonleading_system_message_normalized_for_strict_template -- --exact --nocapture`
- `cargo test -j 8 -p dynamo-llm --lib template -- --nocapture` - 27 passed
- Claude Code 2.1.263 end-to-end test through the Anthropic streaming endpoint, Qwen3.5 strict chat template, TCP request plane, and mocker worker - four `/v1/messages?beta=true` requests completed with HTTP 200 and `status=success`; no strict-template error was emitted. The CLI eventually reached the test's 32-token output cap because the mocker does not emit a model EOS.
- `cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1`
- `cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 --manifest-path lib/bindings/python/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 --manifest-path lib/bindings/kvbm/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p dynamo-llm --lib --locked -- -D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `pre-commit run --files Cargo.toml Cargo.lock lib/bindings/python/Cargo.lock lib/bindings/kvbm/Cargo.lock lib/llm/src/preprocessor.rs`

## Related Issues

- Closes #14550

selected_pull_requests.title: chore: update dynamo-protocols to 5.4.1
selected_pull_requests.body:
## Overview:

Bumps the pinned `dynamo-protocols` dependency from 5.4.0 to 5.4.1, which picks up ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#202 (closes ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#157). That release aligns `/v1/chat/completions` response serialization with the OpenAI spec: optional fields are omitted when absent instead of being emitted as explicit `null`, and the required-and-nullable `refusal` field is always present.

Wire changes visible to clients after this bump:

| Field | Before | After |
| -- | -- | -- |
| top-level `usage` / `service_tier` / `system_fingerprint` (non-stream + stream) | `null` when absent | omitted |
| stream tool-call chunk `id` / `type` / `function.name` on continuation chunks | `null` | omitted |
| `message.reasoning_content` (Dynamo extension) | `null` when absent | omitted |
| `usage.prompt_tokens_details.audio_tokens` etc. | `null` when absent | omitted |
| `message.refusal` | omitted | always present (`null` when no refusal), matching OpenAI |
| `finish_reason`, non-stream `logprobs`, `message.content` | unchanged | unchanged (spec-required) |

Deserialization is unaffected in both directions: payloads with or without the keys decode identically, so mixed-version frontend/worker deployments are safe. Official OpenAI SDKs (pydantic/zod models) are unaffected; only raw dict indexing such as `chunk["usage"]` on intermediate stream chunks would observe the change — and that code already fails against api.openai.com, which never emits those keys.

## Details:

Root `Cargo.toml` moves the pin from `=5.4.0` to `=5.4.1`. That is the only pin site in the tree; `lib/llm/Cargo.toml` and `lib/backend-common/Cargo.toml` inherit it via `workspace = true`.

The three lockfiles are refreshed to match: `Cargo.lock`, `lib/bindings/kvbm/Cargo.lock`, and `lib/bindings/python/Cargo.lock` (the two bindings crates are separate workspaces with their own lockfiles). Each moves exactly one package, `dynamo-protocols 5.4.0 -> 5.4.1`; no other dependency changes.

No Dynamo source changes: 5.4.1 keeps every public type identity (`CompletionUsage` etc. remain upstream re-exports), so this is a pure pin bump.

## Where should the reviewer start?

`Cargo.toml` line 71. Everything else is lockfile churn from `cargo update -p dynamo-protocols --precise 5.4.1`.

## Related Issues

**🔗 This PR is linked to an issue:**

- Relates to ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#157
- Picks up ai-dynamo/frontend-crates#202


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Chores**
  * Updated the Dynamo protocols package to version 5.4.1.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

selected_pull_requests.title: fix(frontend): preserve message rewrites during rendering
selected_pull_requests.body:
## Summary

`NormalizedArgsRequest` rewrites tool arguments and adds the marker used by `continue_final_message`, but its `typed_messages()` override returns the original history. Renderers that prefer typed messages skip those transformations.

Remove that override so this adapter uses its transformed `messages()` representation. Ordinary requests keep the typed fast path. This is the companion fix for [frontend-crates #261](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/frontend-crates/pull/261) and must land before Dynamo adopts that renderer update. Dependency pins remain unchanged.

## Validation

- The new adapter regression checks argument normalization, the continuation marker, rendering, and final truncation; it passed against the patched renderer.
- Existing `continue_final_message` tests passed against the same renderer override.
- The override uses renderer source `466d240f50bc179e449cb4e21b3ffe6222f9a8aa` with the published 5.2.0 dependency manifest, preserving Dynamo's protocol/tokenizer pins and all locked package versions. Override files and lock changes are excluded from this PR.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `git diff --check` passed.

Local test commands used `cargo test -p dynamo-llm --no-default-features --lib`, filtered to `normalized_args_request_preserves_render_transformations` and `continue_final_message`, with the temporary renderer path override.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Improved message rendering to consistently use normalized message content.
  - Corrected rendering of tool-call arguments and continuation markers in final messages.

- **Tests**
  - Added regression coverage to help ensure normalized tool-call arguments and continuation markers remain correctly rendered.

human_reviews.body: **[P1] Shared normalization breaks native DeepSeek V3.2 rendering.** The new mutation in [OAIChatLikeRequest::messages()](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo/blob/6889de80f26dcbd40705cc9a7cad5118f0e17e49/lib/llm/src/preprocessor/prompt.rs#L93-L96) converts arguments to objects for every renderer, but DeepSeek V3.2 requires the original JSON string. Both local testing and [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo/actions/runs/30650810134/job/91223385279) fail the same two existing tests with `Missing or invalid 'arguments' field`. Move normalization to the MiniJinja boundary.

conclusion: Argument-format compatibility is already known. No exact R1 MiniJinja concatenation report identified in this bounded search. Current renderer and full-server behavior remain untested.
